text: Docstring re-read at 0.61.2 and still exact: this test exists because the refusal printed a command that does not run, and it still proves that by EXECUTING what the message prints. The logic moved only in that the affirm which follows the remedy no longer asserts the exact words 're-stamped 1 confirm entry'. It asserts the refusal is gone, because affirm learned to write nothing when nothing is stale, and demanding a specific success message would have made this test fail for a reason it does not care about.
